statements.quote: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, improve our existing offerings, and rapidly and responsibly deploy AI across our businesses.
statements.notes: R&D investment is described as significant, and deploying AI is one of several stated aims alongside new and existing offerings. AI is not singled out as the primary driver. The sentence is in the present tense with no year stated.

statements.quote: We expect to increase, relative to 2023, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers, network equipment, and data centers, to support the growth of our business and our long-term initiatives, in particular in support of AI products and services.
statements.notes: The same sentence appears in p01 and is recorded once here. 'Relative to 2023' implies the following year, but no outlook year is named, so fiscal_year is null. No amount or share is given for AI. The $32.3B 2023 capex in the same passage is not linked to AI in its own sentence, so it is not recorded.
